verdict_reason: The new plantsNotificationApi fixture is correct but unused, while the plants org-scoping spec rebuilds the same client by hand in every test.

todos.issue: The new plantsNotificationApi fixture (ui.ts:144-146) is used by no spec, while tests/plants/security/backend/organisation-scoped-notifications.spec.ts:23,35,46 builds the same client by hand three times (new NotificationApiClient(request, getPlantsBackendBaseUrl(), undefined, E2E_ORGANISATION_ID) - passing undefined applies the same defaults the fixture gets). The animals twin spec does the same beside the existing notificationApi fixture (animals spec:10). So the PR adds a fixture nothing reaches and keeps the set-up copied per test.
todos.fix: Must: the owner-organisation plants client has one home, and every plants (and animals) org-scoping test takes it from there; no spec rebuilds it locally, and no fixture exists that nothing uses. One way: have the plants spec take plantsNotificationApi (and the animals spec notificationApi) as the owner client from the fixture, and build only the other-organisation client inline - or delete plantsNotificationApi if the specs keep their own clients.
